title: Cracked sidewalk slabs
prompt: Seamless tileable texture of a worn city sidewalk viewed straight down (orthographic), edge to edge, about 3 by 3 metres: square concrete slabs about 1.5 m wide separated by dark joints, chipped edges, a few cracks, dark chewing-gum spots, grime collected along the joints, faint water stains. Cold grey concrete. Even flat lighting, no shadows, no perspective, must tile seamlessly in both directions.
intendedUse: Slice B sidewalk surface for Broker (Hove Beach first).
styleConstraints: Must look like it belongs in GTA IV (2008, Liberty City, late-2000s New York analogue), remastered today; not GTA V, not GTA Online
Cold, grey, overcast, wet-city palette; grime, wear and dirt are welcome; warm artificial light against cold surroundings
Grounded and realistic, photographic material detail; no stylisation, no cartoon, no painterly look unless the request says so
Late-2000s objects, technology, signage and typography of that era, without real brands
UI and icons: dark translucent grey/black surfaces, restrained amber/orange/red accents, gritty industrial typography, sharp purposeful shapes, minimal decoration
prohibited: Real brand names, logos, trademarks or copyrighted characters
Rockstar, GTA, Take-Two or any game's logos, UI or artwork
Readable text unless the request gives the exact text
Neon gradients, glossy mobile-app UI, large rounded cards, live-service styling
Modern (post-2010) phones, cars, fashion or technology
Cartoon, anime, comic or exaggerated gore styles
Lighting or shadows baked into tiling textures (unless the request asks for it)
Perspective or visible camera angle in textures meant to tile (textures are flat, orthographic)
